relations.subject: Johann "Hans" Heinrich Eduard Röer
relations.evidence: He studied philosophy under Johann Friedrich Herbart and wrote a dissertation De Spinosae systematis principiis quaestio metaphysica, 1832

relations.subject: Johann "Hans" Heinrich Eduard Röer
relations.evidence: He became a postdoctorate of philosophy at Berlin in 1833.

relations.subject: Johann "Hans" Heinrich Eduard Röer
relations.evidence: He studied Sanskrit with Franz Bopp and became interested in Indian philosophy.

relations.subject: Johann "Hans" Heinrich Eduard Röer
relations.evidence: He then joined the East India Company and worked in schools in Bengal.

relations.subject: Johann "Hans" Heinrich Eduard Röer
relations.evidence: became a librarian for the Asiatic Society of Bengal in 1841

relations.subject: Johann "Hans" Heinrich Eduard Röer
relations.evidence: He headed the linguistic department of the Asiatic Society from 1847

relations.subject: Johann "Hans" Heinrich Eduard Röer
relations.evidence: From 1847 he was an editor of the Bibliotheca Indica.
